query: Help me understand what's in these food-product reviews and what's worth attention or actionable.

per_column.name: product_category
per_column.rationale: Gives a strong new grouping axis to segment reviews by product type, directly useful for understanding 'what's in these reviews.' Categories are soundly inferred from source text (dog food->pet_food, peanuts->processed_snack, taffy->candy_confection). Some overlapping/redundant categories (beverage_coffee vs coffee_tea, tea_beverage) are a minor schema-hygiene issue but not a groundedness failure.

per_column.name: primary_complaint_type
per_column.rationale: Highly actionable axis directly answering 'what's worth attention' by surfacing and categorizing complaints (quality defect, taste, shipping, health/safety). Samples map well to source (mislabeled peanuts->quality_defect, medicinal flavor->taste_flavor_issue, positive reviews->no_complaint). Well grounded.

per_column.name: product_quality_assessment
per_column.rationale: Provides a graded quality ordinal useful for prioritization. Partially correlated with Score and with complaint_type, but the graded scale (excellent/good/acceptable/poor/concerning/defective) adds resolution beyond a 1-5 star. Sample mappings are reasonable, though 'concerning' for a merely medicinal-flavored extract is a mild overreach. Generally sound.

per_column.name: taste_flavor_perception
per_column.rationale: Isolates the taste dimension, a genuine analytic axis for a food dataset. Values are mostly warranted from text. The domain is somewhat noisy/redundant (good_taste vs excellent_taste vs positive_flavor_descriptor vs smooth_balanced overlap), slightly diluting leverage, but core signal is grounded. NULL for silent rows is correct behavior.

per_column.name: price_value_perception
per_column.rationale: Captures price/value sentiment, a distinct actionable axis not present in originals. Correctly emits Unknown/NULL when text is silent (peanut, confection, extract samples) and good_value when stated ('great price'). Grounded and appropriately restrained on silent rows.

judge.rationale: All five columns provide genuine, non-trivial axes (category, complaint type, quality, taste, price/value) that materially help an analyst triage and understand these food reviews and identify actionable issues. Values are consistently sound readings of the source text, with appropriate Unknown/NULL handling for silent rows and no observed fabrication. Minor weaknesses are internal redundancy within some category vocabularies and partial overlap between quality/complaint/taste columns, which slightly lowers usefulness on a couple of columns but does not breach the necessary conditions.
